description_en: Deletes an auto scaling event and resource change notification
description_zh: 删除一条弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知
kebab_example: aliyun ess delete-notification-configuration --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --notification-arn acs:ess:cn-beijing:1614568843400000:cloudmonitor --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteNotificationConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The identity of the Notification Recipient. The parameter format varies by notification method:

monitoring: `acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor`.
MNS queue: `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`.
MNS topic: `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`.

The variables in the parameter format have the following meanings:

region-id: the region ID of the scaling group.
account-id: the Alibaba Cloud account ID.
queuename: the name of the MNS queue.
topicname: the name of the MNS topic
parameters.help_zh:
通知对象标识符，各通知方式的参数格式如下：

云监控，参数取值格式：`acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor`。
MNS队列，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`。
MNS主题，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`。

参数格式中的变量含义如下：

region-id：伸缩组所属的地域ID。
account-id：阿里云账号ID。
queuename：MNS队列的名称。
topicname：MNS主题的名称
parameters.name: notification_arn

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id
